label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.7 a.1… supports The esse of every creature is received in…
note: The claim's interpretation records that q.7 a.2 co. denies infinity simpliciter to a subsistent created form because its esse is received and contracted to a determinate nature. That bears on the premise for subsistent created forms; that the esse of every creature is received in some principle is the analyst's generalization.
